name: Sociality.io
description:
Connect Claude to your Sociality.io workspace to analyze social media performance, competitor activity, and post-level results in one conversation. Ask Claude to review account metrics, compare tracked competitors, summarize content performance, and find patterns across Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

Use Sociality MCP to turn your social media data into practical reporting, benchmarking, and competitive research workflows. It helps marketers, agencies, and social media teams understand what changed, what performed well, and where to focus next.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sociality.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sociality.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.sociality.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sociality.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sociality.io provides these MCP tools: social_account_posts_list, social_account_stats_list, social_accounts_list, social_competitor_posts_list, social_competitor_stats_list, social_competitors_create, and social_competitors_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sociality.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sociality.io in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Sociality.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sociality.io is developed by Sociality.io Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
